description: This file provides helper methods for testing the MigraDoc Document Object Model, including creating documents, sections, tables, paragraphs, styles, and formatted text for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestHelper
classes.description: A static helper class providing methods to generate and manipulate MigraDoc documents and components for testing.

methods.name: RemoveStyles
methods.description: Removes all styles from the document except for default paragraph font and normal styles.

methods.name: CreateParagraphsWithStyles
methods.description: Creates a sequence of paragraphs with predefined heading styles.

methods.name: CreateParagraphsWithOwnStyles
methods.description: Creates paragraphs with custom styles, adding styles to the document if they do not already exist.

methods.name: CreateParagraphWithFormattedText
methods.description: Creates a paragraph with various formatted text segments, including bold, color, size, superscript, and font name, as well as character insertion.

methods.name: CreateSimpleTable
methods.description: Creates a simple 2x2 table with sample data.

methods.name: CreateComplexTable
methods.description: Creates a complex table with multiple rows, merged cells, shading, borders, and formatted text.

methods.name: CreateComplexSections
methods.description: Generates multiple sections containing various content such as headers, tables, styled paragraphs, and formatted text, for comprehensive testing.

methods.name: CreateTestDocument
methods.description: Creates a new MigraDoc Document populated with different content configurations based on the specified TestDocument enum.

methods.name: TestData
methods.description: Provides enumerable test data objects representing different document types for parameterized testing.

methods.name: TestDocuments
methods.description: Enumeration of different document test scenarios.
